Our bodies are home to a microbiome of good bacteria that can help support daily bodily functions. California Gold Nutrition Probiotics contains 10 different strains of these good bacteria, which can help support digestive and immune health.*

Benefits of Taking Probiotic Supplements

Though our bodies have naturally-occurring good bacteria, sometimes our natural microbiome can become unbalanced with too few good bacteria. This can potentially create an environment where bad bacteria can thrive, which may cause digestive issues. Taking a daily probiotic supplement can help to balance the body’s microbiome with enough good bacteria to help support digestive and immune health.*

California Gold Nutrition Probiotics contains a 10 strain blend of probiotics with 25 billion CFU in veggie capsules. When taken as directed, this provides approximately a 2-month supply.

Our products undergo quality testing where they are evaluated by an independent ISO-certified lab using scientifically-validated test methods to ensure authenticity, purity, and potency of ingredients. For added transparency, we make the results available to you in our iTested Verified Reports so you can see for yourself.

Check out the iTested Report for this product to see the analysis.

Suggested use
Take 1 capsule daily, with or without food. Best when taken as directed by a qualified healthcare professional.

Warning
Keep out of reach of children. Consult with a licensed physician, pharmacist, naturopath or other qualified healthcare professional prior to taking dietary supplements. Sealed for your protection. Do not use if seal is missing or broken. Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from heat, light, and moisture. Best kept refrigerated to maintain potency. Natural color variation may occur. Do not eat freshness packet, keep in bottle.

Main Ingredients Probiotic Bacteria Blend: Lactobacillus acidophilus, Bifidobacterium lactis, Lactobacillus plantarum, Lactobacillus casei, Lactobacillus rhamnosus, Lactobacillus paracasei, Bifidobacterium breve, Streptococcus thermophilus, Lactobacillus salivarius, Bifidobacterium longum. Other Ingredients Microcrystalline Cellulose, Modified Cellulose (Hypromellose Veggie Capsule), Fructooligosaccharides (FOS), Ascorbyl Palmitate, and Silicon Dioxide (Silica). When it comes to effective probiotics, clinically documented Strains Matter®. As an innovator of consumer probiotics since 1986, Jarrow Formulas® takes great pride in using high-quality and scientifically documented strains that have been developed through years of research and innovation.

8 Clinically Studied Strains in an Enhanced Probiotic System™ (EPS)

Jarro-Dophilus® EPS supports the health of the intestinal tract with a balanced mixture of carefully selected probiotic strains for intestinal and immune health. These strains have been clinically shown to have a positive influence on intestinal and/or immune health.

Our 8 complementary strains of probiotic bacteria are delivered via proprietary enteric coated capsules (EnteroGuard®) that protect it from stomach acid and delivers the potency of friendly bacteria needed to support a healthy gut. Jarro-Dophilus® EPS is blister-packed to protect the capsules from moisture and room temperature stable so it does not require refrigeration.

Live Probiotic Guarantee

When kept under recommended storage conditions, Jarrow® Probiotics are formulated to ensure CFU counts are guaranteed within best used before date.

EnteroGuard® - Protects Probiotics from Stomach Acid

Blister Packed - Protects Probiotic Bacteria from Moisture and Oxygen for Superior Stability
